endpoints.purpose: Find the teacher registration record required before a licence status update.
endpoints.notes: The UUID, UAT environment template, and extraction paths were verified against a successful read-only UAT response on 2026-07-31.

endpoints.purpose: Update the registration status using the national ID and qr_link returned by the lookup.
endpoints.notes: Verified in the UAT Endpoints collection. The URL resolves through teacher_reg_backend_base_url and supplies endorsement_status and qr_link as enabled query parameters. Stored example values must be replaced at execution time. Confirmation is mandatory because this is state-changing.
